newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical extends offer for Circon.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical extends offer for Circon.

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp said Friday it had extended until June 16 its $17-per-share cash tender offer for all outstandting common shares of Circon Corp.
It said 7.8 million shares of Circon had been tendered as of February 13.
Those shares, plus 1.0 million previously purchased by U.S. Surgical, represent 79 percent of the shares of Circon not owned by Circon management and members of its board, U.S. Surgical said.
U.S. Surgical, which makes surgical products, launched its hostile takeover bid August 2, 1996.
Circon manufactures endoscopes and other miniature medical equipment.
